newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Woodside has 99 metre Laminaria oil column.
newsitem.headline: Woodside has 99 metre Laminaria oil column.

text.p: Woodside Petroleum Ltd said on Tuesday the Laminaria-4 development well encountered an oil column indicated at a gross 99 metres.
The Laminaria oil field, in the Timor Sea, is located in permits AC/L5 and AC/P8.
Woodside said the well has reached a total depth of 3371.5 metres and had completed final wireline logging.
"Preliminary log interpretation indicates a gross 99 metre oil column," it said.
A seven-inch completion liner has been run, and will be cemented prior to suspending the well for future completion.
The AC/L5 and AC/P8 joint venture is 50 percent owned by Woodside, 25 percent each by The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd and Shell Development Australia, a unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group.
Last month the three companies approved the development of the Laminaria and nearby Corallina oil fields at a cost of about A$1 billion.
At 1.20 p.m. (0320 GMT), Woodside shares were 32 cents or 2.86 percent down at A$10.86.
